_note: PLACEHOLDER written by Claude. Owner D: replace these and delete this line. Between two floors the player picks one of `offered` random choices. Each choice has a name, a text and effects. Effects the game understands (systems/choices.py): gold (get gold), item (get an item id), lose_hp (lose HP now, never below 1), max_hp (raise max HP), next_floor (changes for the next floor: elite_bonus is added to the elite chance, extra_chests and extra_enemies are added to the counts). Nothing here heals: only items heal.

choices.name: Field Rations
choices.text: Take a small potion for the road. Safe and simple.

choices.name: Heavy Training
choices.text: Lose 20 HP now. Your maximum HP grows by 15 for good.

choices.name: Sealed Vault
choices.text: The next floor has 2 more chests, but elite monsters are much more common.

choices.name: Greedy Shortcut
choices.text: Gain 40 gold now. The next floor has 3 more monsters.

choices.name: Quiet Path
choices.text: Nothing gained, nothing lost. Elite monsters are rarer on the next floor.
